title: Attested snapshot
description: Attested snapshot of a pool schedule extraction. Locks a canonical payload to a source hash. Attestor is human Save, CI publish-pending, or carry.

slug.description: Pool slug. Must match the containing directory name.

pdf_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source PDF bytes. Locks this snapshot to that exact document.

reviewed_at.description: Pacific date of the attestor action (human Save or CI publish-pending), not necessarily a human cell check.

attested_by.description: Who signed this snapshot. Omit on legacy files. Carry copies the prior value and sets carried_from.

carried_from.description: Repo-relative path of a prior attested snapshot (human, CI, or omitted attested_by) this one was auto-carried from. reviewed_at keeps the original attestation date.

source_pdf_url.description: Canonical URL the PDF was fetched from at review time.

effective_start.description: Start of the window this schedule is valid for.

schedule_basis.description: What the source proves: a true swim schedule, pool hours, facility hours, amenity existence, temporary closure, or unknown.

effective_end.description: Optional end date of the schedule window. Null or omitted if open-ended.

sessions.description: Weekly swim sessions. May be empty when access_hours carries an access-only source.

access_hours.description: Weekly facility, member, or public day-use access windows that are not strong enough to count as swim sessions.

access_exceptions.description: Date-specific access windows that override weekly access_hours, such as holiday hours.

type.description: Session category. Add new values here first, then teach the template.

end.description: 24-hour end time, HH:MM. Must be strictly greater than start.

pool.description: Optional sub-pool identifier for multi-pool venues (e.g. 'deep', 'shallow').

evidence.description: Optional verbatim PDF line this session came from. Stripped on canonicalization.

notes.description: Optional reviewer note. Stripped on canonicalization.

end.description: Must be ≥ start. Single-day closures use start == end.

start_time.description: Optional 24-hour HH:MM marking the start of a partial-day closure. Required together with end_time. Only valid on single-day closures (start == end).

end_time.description: Optional 24-hour HH:MM marking the end of a partial-day closure. Must be strictly greater than start_time.
